record.paper_title: Group actions on 4-manifolds: some recent results and open questions
record.context_brief: Non-holomorphic fixed-point structures for K3-group actions
record.original_question: Are there smooth or symplectic actions of a K3 group on a homotopy K3 surface whose fixed-point set structure (X_G, {ρ_x}) is different from the fixed-point set structure of a holomorphic action?

evidence.quote: Question 3.4. (Chen-Kwasik [21]) Are there any smooth or symplectic actions of a K3 group on a homotopy K3 surface which have a fixed-point set structure (XG, {ρx}) different than a holomorphic action?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A homotopy K3 surface is a closed smooth 4-manifold homeomorphic to a K3 surface. A K3 group is a finite group that admits a faithful holomorphic and symplectic action on some K3 surface (equivalently, a finite group that occurs as a group of symplectic automorphisms of some complex K3 surface; by Mukai's theorem these are precisely the subgroups of the Mathieu group M_23 having at least five orbits in their natural action on 24 letters).

Given a smooth (resp. symplectic) action of a finite group G on a homotopy K3 surface X, define its fixed-point set structure to be the pair (X^G, {ρ_x}_{x ∈ X^G}), where X^G is the fixed-point set of G and, for each x ∈ X^G, ρ_x is the isotropy representation of G on the tangent space T_x X (viewed as a real, resp. symplectic, representation up to equivalence).

Question: Does there exist a K3 group G, a homotopy K3 surface X, and a smooth (or symplectic) action of G on X such that the fixed-point set structure (X^G, {ρ_x}) does not coincide with the fixed-point set structure of any holomorphic action of G on any complex K3 surface?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal substantial work by Chen–Kwasik and others establishing rigidity theorems showing fixed-point set structures of symplectic K3-group actions often match those of holomorphic actions for prime-order elements and certain groups, but no source confirms a complete resolution of the general question. Status appears unresolved in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Symplectic symmetries of 4-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Chen-Kwasik study fixed-point sets of symplectic actions on homotopy K3 surfaces using G-equivariant Seiberg-Witten-Taubes theory.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational work on the question; partial rigidity results but general question not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Symplectic S5 action on symplectic homotopy K3 surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies symplectic S5 actions on homotopy K3 surfaces; results consistent with holomorphic models.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent partial results in special cases.
